name: Turak Runetotem
summary: In Thunder Bluff, Turak Runetotem guides young tauren toward nature and balance. From the Hall of Elders on Elder Rise, he assists Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem and leads novices through trials to commune with spirits and master animal forms.

sections.title: Voice of the Earthmother
sections.body: In the Hall of Elders atop Thunder Bluff’s Elder Rise, Turak Runetotem guides those who seek the druid’s path. He assists Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem in bringing the ancient druidic arts back among the tauren. Turak teaches that a druid honors the Earthmother’s will. Strength of body must rest upon spiritual respect and harmony with nature.

sections.title: The Path of the Claw
sections.body: When fledgling druids are ready for animal forms, Turak sends them into the wider world. He teaches them to join the Cenarion Circle and travel by teleportation across Kalimdor to Moonglade. Turak remembers his own first communion with the Great Bear Spirit as bewildering and intense. To test his students’ courage, he sends them to face Lunaclaw and win the strength of body and heart required for the Path of the Claw.

sections.title: Guardians of Balance
sections.body:
Turak teaches more than the primal forms of combat. He sends his disciples to Dendrite Starblaze to study poison, and Dendrite sends them to help animals poisoned near the Crossroads. Even Turak is surprised by the rash of poisonings.

Turak also guides novices through arduous rites beneath the tides, where they awaken their aquatic form. These trials shape them into protectors able to heal Azeroth’s deepest wounds.

faq.q: Where can I find Turak Runetotem?
faq.answer: Find Turak Runetotem in the Hall of Elders on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, alongside Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem.

faq.q: What role does Turak play for new druids?
faq.answer: Turak teaches young tauren druids to reach Moonglade and guides them through trials for their Bear and Aquatic forms. He also teaches them to cure natural poisons.

faq.q: What is Turak's connection to Moonglade?
faq.answer: Turak teaches novice druids to teleport to Moonglade. There, Dendrite Starblaze offers advanced spiritual guidance through the Cenarion Circle.

faq.q: How is Turak related to Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem?
faq.answer: Turak belongs to the Runetotem tribe and serves Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem as a trusted assistant and teacher in the Hall of Elders.

faq.q: Why does Turak send druids to the Crossroads?
faq.answer: Turak sends students to Dendrite Starblaze in Moonglade to study poison. Dendrite sends them to help with animal poisonings near the Crossroads. When they return, Turak grants them the power to cure poison permanently.

faq.q: What was Turak's personal experience with the Great Bear Spirit?
faq.answer: Turak recalls that his first communion with the Great Bear Spirit, on the path to becoming a Druid of the Claw, was bewildering and profoundly intense. The experience deepened his reverence for the form.

angles.text: As a tauren druid, you can learn from Turak Runetotem. He teaches the path to Moonglade and tests aspirants for their Bear and Aquatic forms.
As a tauren, you share in the revival of druidic customs after the Third War. Turak Runetotem helps your people reclaim their ancient harmony with the Earthmother.
As a member of the Horde, you can look to Turak Runetotem, who trains nature’s guardians to face blights, environmental corruption, and the lingering scars across Kalimdor.
